phrases.Portare l'attenzione al respiro crea un: Focusing on your breath creates a simple anchor. It is useful when you want to slow down before sleep or after an intense day.
phrases.Alleni il ritorno dell'attenzione al mom: You train your ability to return attention to the present moment. It helps concentration and awareness without trying to 'empty' your mind.
phrases.Sposti progressivamente l'attenzione sul: You gradually move attention through different areas of the body. It suits recovery and preparation for sleep.
phrases.Ti invita a riconoscere intenzionalmente: It invites you to intentionally notice people, events or small positive parts of the day without ignoring difficulties.
phrases.Immagina in modo concreto il processo ch: Visualize the process you want to face in concrete terms. Use it as mental practice, not as a replacement for real planning.

phrases.Ti dà un ritmo semplice da seguire quand: It gives you a simple rhythm to follow when you want to slow down, shift attention from thoughts to body sensations and create an intentional pause.
phrases.4 secondi inspira + 4 secondi espira. È: Inhale for 4 seconds and exhale for 4 seconds. It is the simplest way to start and create a steady rhythm without breath holds.
phrases.Inspira, trattieni, espira e trattieni a: Inhale, hold, exhale and hold empty for 4 seconds each. It helps when you want a precise sequence to follow and stronger focus on rhythm.
phrases.4 secondi inspira, 7 trattieni, 8 espira: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7 and exhale for 8. The longer exhale slows the practice down. If holding is uncomfortable, return to 4–4 without forcing it.
phrases.Siediti comodo, lascia rilassate spalle: Sit comfortably, relax your shoulders and jaw, breathe without filling your lungs to the maximum and stop if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable. Perfect timing matters less than comfort.
phrases.Allena il ritorno intenzionale dell'atte: It trains your ability to intentionally return attention to the present moment. It does not mean eliminating thoughts; it means noticing distraction and returning to an anchor.
phrases.Scegli 1, 3 o 5 minuti. Ogni 20 secondi: Choose 1, 3 or 5 minutes. Every 20 seconds a new prompt brings you back to breath, body, sounds or observing thoughts.
phrases.Leggi la frase senza trasformarla in un: Read the prompt without turning it into a task you must perform perfectly. If you get distracted, that is normal: notice it and return to the prompt or breath.
phrases.Ti aiuta a notare in modo sistematico te: It helps you systematically notice tension, pressure, temperature and contact across the body. It is especially useful when you feel tense or want to slow down before rest.
phrases.La mappa illumina Testa, Spalle/Petto, B: The map highlights Head, Shoulders/Chest, Arms, Abdomen, Legs and Feet for 10 seconds each and gives you a specific cue.
phrases.Non cercare per forza di rilassare una z: Do not force an area to relax. Observe it first. If you feel tension, soften it during the exhale; if it does not change, simply continue to the next area.
phrases.È uno spazio per registrare intenzionalm: It is a space to intentionally record experiences, people or small details you want to remember. It is not about denying the day's difficulties.
phrases.Puoi usare lo spunto casuale quando non: Use the random prompt when you do not know what to write. Each note is saved with its date and remains available in “Your happy memories”.
phrases.Meglio una cosa specifica che una frase: A specific detail is better than a generic sentence: instead of “I am grateful for my friends”, try “Marco's call on my way home made me smile”. Even one sentence is enough.

phrases.Perché: regola recupero, glicemia, stres: Why: it regulates recovery, blood glucose, stress, muscle growth and alertness. Sleeping under 7 h can reduce recovery and performance.
phrases.Perché: stress elevato aumenta catabolis: Why: high stress increases catabolic load, worsens recovery and can reduce motivation and sleep quality.

phrases.Perché: la dieta è il carburante del rec: Why: nutrition fuels recovery and performance. Too much or too little energy can affect performance, recovery and body composition.

phrases.OMS <10% dell'energia, idealmente <5%; a: WHO: <10% of energy, ideally <5%; at 2000 kcal this is about <50 g, ideally <25 g/day of free sugars.
phrases.EFSA circa 950–1000 mg/die per molti adu: EFSA: about 950–1000 mg/day for many adults depending on age. Upper limits can depend on age and source; avoid high-dose supplementation without professional guidance.
phrases.350 mg/die uomini, 300 mg/die donne. I l: 350 mg/day for men, 300 mg/day for women. Supplement limits should not be confused with magnesium naturally present in foods.
phrases.<5 g sale/die, equivalenti a <2 g sodio/: <5 g salt/day, equivalent to <2 g sodium/day. This is not a target to reach.

keys.workout.plan_stays_active: The plan stays active every day. There are no exercises scheduled today.
keys.help.home.title: Home
keys.help.home.date.body: Home always opens on the current day. Change the date to review a past day without changing today's data. Cards use the selected date for water, nutrition, workout, wellness and meditation.
keys.help.home.avatar.body: The avatar reflects daily progress with many sarcastic and motivational lines. Some change with the time of day and, when you are signed in with Google, can use your first name. Tap the avatar to cycle the message.
keys.help.home.focus.body: Temporarily hides secondary Home information and keeps summary, avatar, quick actions, coach and priorities visible. It deletes nothing and can be disabled at any time.
keys.help.home.coach.body: The coach only uses data already in Thalys to give a short suggestion. The weekly insight summarizes workouts, hydration and mind sessions without push notifications.
keys.help.workout.title: Workout
keys.help.workout.plans.body: Plan creation shows weekdays horizontally below the plan name. Pick a day and add exercises with category, sets, reps, weight, RPE and rest. Any accidentally added exercise can be removed. Mouse-wheel scrolling works directly in the editor on desktop.
keys.help.workout.active.body: The active plan stays selected until you change it. If no exercises are assigned to a day, that day is Scheduled Rest and does not reduce the smart streak.
keys.help.workout.import.body: Export a plan to keep it or share it through WhatsApp, Mail or other apps. Import recreates exercises and days without automatically changing the active plan.
keys.help.workout.complete.body: Checks apply only to exercises scheduled for the selected date. Completion feeds daily progress and insights; rest days are not treated as missed workouts.
keys.help.mind.title: Mind
keys.help.mind.breath.body: Choose 4–4 for a simple rhythm, Box for a structured sequence or 4–7–8 for a longer exhale. The orb visually follows each phase; ambient sound can remain active throughout.
keys.help.mind.checkin.body: Helps you quickly choose a practice that matches how you feel. It is not a diagnosis; it simply highlights the most suitable tool among breathing, mindfulness, body scan and gratitude.
keys.help.mind.history.body: The date at the top selects the day you are viewing. Completed sessions are stored with their date; history and weekly minutes update accordingly.
keys.help.mind.audio.body: Sounds use the MP3 files located beside index.html. Volume is independent from the practice timer and sound can continue while you move between Mind tools.
keys.help.nutrition.title: Nutrition
keys.help.nutrition.meals.body: Each meal has its own + button. Opening it preselects Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner or Snack. Amount and per-100-g values are automatically converted to the consumed serving.
keys.help.nutrition.targets.body: Nutrition targets drive summaries and charts. The 7-day view shows all quantitative macro and micronutrients, including zinc and water; water- and fat-soluble vitamins are shown as coverage because Thalys records presence rather than dosage.
keys.help.nutrition.database.body: When the Food Database opens, the foods loaded from Drive use the available space. After you tap +, the manual/AI entry area uses about half the screen while the saved-food list stays visible and scrollable. Barcode and AI also include zinc when available; nothing is saved without your confirmation.
keys.help.nutrition.water.body: Buttons add or subtract 250 ml for the selected date. The target can be customized and is used for daily progress, Home and weekly insights.
keys.help.body.title: Body
keys.help.body.profile.body: Biological sex, age, height and lifestyle are used for calculations such as BMR and avatar selection. Sleep is not here because it is a daily Health Status value.
keys.help.body.measure.body: Stores weight and circumferences with a date. For trends, measuring consistently at the same point and under similar conditions matters more than chasing millimeter precision.
keys.help.body.avatar.body: Thalys loads male.svg or female.svg directly from the repository. Update data performs a forced cache-busted refresh, saves the selected gender again and redraws Body and Home.
keys.help.body.photos.body: Progress Photos opens a full page. Add photos with Date, View and Part; filter, favorite, open, share and save them. Metadata is also kept in the Drive photo index.
keys.help.analytics.title: Charts
keys.help.analytics.filter.body: The global filter changes the same time range for all charts. The workout selector limits strength/volume data without changing saved history.
keys.help.analytics.health.body: The overview reads the selected Health Status day. Sleep, stress, recovery and readiness are descriptive indicators used to contextualize training and recovery, not to diagnose.
keys.help.analytics.body.body: Select multiple circumferences to compare them over time. Charts never modify data; they only display measurements saved in Body.
keys.help.analytics.nutrition.body: Calories, macros and meditation are aggregated from daily logs. A day with no data is shown as missing data, not as a negative evaluation.
keys.help.settings.title: Options
keys.help.settings.account.body: Profile photo and connection status are linked to the account. Green means Drive connected; red means local mode. Signing out does not automatically delete local data.
keys.help.settings.sync.body: Local storage and Drive work together. Sync now forces database upload; Reload from Drive reads the cloud again. On errors Thalys protects the local copy instead of deleting it.
keys.help.settings.backup.body: Export ZIP downloads the entire Thalys App to your device, including subfolders and files. Import ZIP or Import folder recreates contents on Drive; Rename backup changes the backup folder name.
keys.help.settings.language.body: Translations are loaded from language databases. Thalys tries Google Drive first, then the local file shipped with the app, then the device cache. Changing language never changes saved data.
keys.coach.morning: Good morning. Start small: completing the first goal makes the rest of the day feel lighter.
keys.coach.afternoon: Good afternoon. Look at what truly remains, not everything you could possibly do.
keys.coach.evening: Good evening. Close the day well: even five minutes of mind practice or a check-in counts.
keys.insight.none: This week is still empty: log something and Thalys will build a useful summary without judging you.
keys.insight.good: Solid week: you are building consistency across several areas, not just one goal.
keys.insight.hydration: Hydration is the easiest area to improve this week: a few small reminders during the day may be enough.
keys.insight.mind: You logged little mind time: you do not need a long session; a few minutes is a good start.
keys.milestone.first_workout.title: Achievement · First workout completed
keys.milestone.first_workout.body: First plan completed. Nothing changes in your score: it is simply a small signal that the system is starting to have real data about you.
keys.milestone.streak7.title: Achievement · 7 consistent workouts
keys.milestone.streak7.body: You reached a smart streak of 7 workouts: scheduled rest days did not break the streak.
keys.help.consult.title: Consult
keys.help.consult.snapshot.body: A snapshot is an immutable copy of data for the selected period. Physical includes measurements and wellness status; Nutrition includes logs, targets and water; Workouts includes history, completion and the active plan; Full combines all areas and Mind sessions. Saving a snapshot does not call AI.
keys.help.consult.goal.body: The goal travels with the snapshot and guides analysis. The same data can lead to different advice depending on whether you want strength, body composition, recovery or nutrition improvements. Use a preset or custom goal.
keys.help.consult.ai.body: AI is called only when you press Analyze with AI. Thalys sends the selected snapshot, goal and optional request to the Vercel server; the API key stays server-side. The response is saved in ai_consults.json so you can review and filter it later.
keys.help.consult.workout.body: For Workouts, choose a snapshot and a plan already in Thalys. AI compares frequency, volume, recovery, progression and plan structure. If you like the advice, I like it · generate plan requests JSON in the same format as the Thalys importer; it is normalized before import and is not activated automatically.
keys.help.consult.food.body: Ask for per-100-g values from Consult or directly in Food Database using the AI button beside the name. The server tries Open Food Facts first and uses AI to normalize or complete missing data. Fields are only prefilled: you always review, edit and press Save yourself.
keys.help.consult.history.body: consultations.json stores snapshots and ai_consults.json stores AI answers. Tap a saved snapshot to open a dedicated viewer without losing your page position; from there you can export TXT or a branded Thalys PDF. Filters and deletion remain available.
keys.help.nutrition.ai_food.body: In the New food form, the wand button looks up nutrition values per 100 g. Thalys prefers data found on Open Food Facts and asks AI to complete or normalize them. No food is saved automatically: always review the proposed values, then edit or save.
keys.help.settings.access.body: Options no longer occupies a slot in the bottom bar: open it from the gear in the header beside the profile photo. The bottom bar stays dedicated to operational areas and the new Consult section. Options automatically opens at the top.

keys.help.workout.history.body: When all planned exercises are completed for a day, Thalys automatically stores the session in workout_history.json and the individual exercises in workouts.json. Filter completed sessions by date.
keys.help.nutrition.database_meals.body: Meal Database now shows one compact row per date. Tap a date to open Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack details.
keys.help.nutrition.charts.body: Each nutrient has an equal-size slice. The brighter area shows the target percentage reached, while the darker area shows what is still missing.
keys.help.analytics.strength.body: The chart now shows only lifted-weight progression for a specific exercise. Exercise names are matched case-insensitively, so “leg press” and “Leg press” are treated as the same exercise.
keys.help.settings.drive_creation.body: On first access Thalys asks once to create the structure and all databases. Later it automatically checks for missing files, recreates them and shows only one notice.
keys.help.settings.ios_compatibility.body: Thalys V10 gestisce viewport dinamico iOS, overlay/modali, scroll touch e refresh versione. Se iOS mantiene una vecchia sessione, l'app esegue un solo reload cache-busted quando rileva una versione nuova.
keys.help.settings.pdf_export.body: From V12 PDF export uses jsPDF 2.5.1 with multi-CDN fallback. PDFs remain native A4 documents rather than screenshots.
keys.appearance_desc: Choose light or dark mode. Your choice is kept for the next launch.
keys.help.settings.appearance.body: Choose light or dark mode. Your choice is kept for the next launch.
keys.help.settings.modals.body: From V14 all dialogs use one system: the background is locked while a dialog is open, scrolling stays in the foreground dialog, and switching sections automatically clears stale overlays.
keys.help.settings.ios_navigation.body: From V15 tab switching uses one synchronous path and always restores pointer-events, touch-action and background locks before opening the next section, preventing the iPhone lock after Consult.
keys.help.settings.profile_photo.body: By default Thalys shows your Google account photo. If you upload a photo in Thalys, it becomes an app-specific override stored in foto_profilo.json on Drive and reused on your other devices. Use Google removes the override.
keys.help.nutrition.barcode.body: The camera opens directly from the user gesture, then Thalys uses BarcodeDetector when available or ZXing as a fallback. Permission errors no longer lock the app.
keys.help.navigation.swipe.body: Swipe horizontally on the main content: right goes to the next section, left to the previous one. Swipe is ignored inside dialogs, controls and horizontal scrollers.
keys.help.nutrition.target_calculator.body: Uses sex, age, height and weight from Body, estimates lean mass with Boer and fat mass by subtraction, then combines two BMR estimates with activity, physiological state and goal. Values remain editable before saving a target plan. Plans can be viewed, activated, filtered, imported/exported as JSON and PDF. The dedicated database is nutrition_targets.json.
